entries.desc: DONE pre-check row 暴露稳定 id/status/detail/hint/source/blocking 语义，status renderer 可按 id 与 hint 渲染，不依赖 label 文案。

evidence.note: Truth source now documents stable oracle row contract fields used between gates and renderers.

entries.desc: 新增 delivery-check 或 summary 等失败项时，row hint 能被 status/next 直接消费，label 文案变化不影响 next step。

evidence.note: assertSessionBriefStatusHintsMatchGates verifies delivery-check and story-summary row hints drive status/next even when labels are display text.

entries.desc: renderer 若只知道 phase=TEST 但没有调用 DONE oracle rows，不得输出乐观 story_advance DONE 提示；必须降级指向 pre-check 失败项。

evidence.note: assertValidateHintsFollowStoryPhase and TEST next assertions prevent phase-only optimistic DONE guidance without consulting current gate state.

entries.desc: TEST 阶段缺 git clean、delivery-check、summary 时，status next step 显示这些具体失败项与补救命令，而不是直接提示 DONE。

evidence.note: Truth source now states status/session_brief/next must render gate oracle rows instead of duplicating gate rules.

entries.desc: 存在 docs 相关 git touchpoint 但未显式记录 docs reviewer 时，status 与 artifact contract 都要求 docs reviewer，不出现一个显示一个不显示。

evidence.note: assertReviewerStatusUsesMdFallback checks status and artifact-contract both require docs reviewer from git markdown touchpoints.

entries.desc: finding 已 resolved 或 reviewer evidence 已通过时，Anti-stall 不得继续渲染 blocked by unresolved findings 这类过期阻塞文案。

evidence.note: assertSessionBriefStatusHintsMatchGates verifies resolved findings do not render REVIEW blocked by unresolved findings.

entries.desc: flow-stability smoke 构造 TEST story，断言 status/next 输出包含 delivery_check_set、summary_set、git commit 等真实 DONE pre-check 失败项。

evidence.note: Testing infra docs now require validate success hints to be phase-aware and TEST to consult DONE pre-check rows.

entries.desc: smoke 覆盖 docs reviewer fallback 与 artifact/status 一致性，防止 docs gate 被 status 漏显。

evidence.note: Smoke coverage asserts docs reviewer fallback consistency between summarizeReviewerStatus and getArtifactContractStatus.

entries.desc: smoke 覆盖 resolved finding 后 anti-stall 不显示 unresolved blocker，防止旧阻塞文案复发。

evidence.note: Smoke coverage asserts resolved finding anti-stall regression stays fixed and stale blocker wording is absent.
